chunks: That when al-Hajjaj finished the construction of the Ka'bah, he asked Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام to place the Stone in its position, so he took it and placed it in its position.

key_terms.الْحَجَرَ: the Stone, meaning the Black Stone
key_terms.الْحَجَّاجَ: al-Hajjaj, the ruler mentioned in the report
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام

ai.seo_question: What does the narration say about Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام placing the Stone in the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This report recounts that after the rebuilding of the Ka'bah, al-Hajjaj asked Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام to place the Stone back in its place. The narration highlights the Imam's recognized status in connection with the sacred sanctuary and the rites of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "When Al-Hajjaj completed the rebuilding of the Kaaba, he asked Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn (as) to place the Black Stone in its position. Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn (as) took it and placed it in its proper place."
